answer_1.quote: Generating a natural language summary to explain a chart has numerous benefits and potential applications ... In this paper, we present a neural model for chart summarization by extending a transformer‑based model.

answer_2.quote: For automated evaluation of our summary quality, we employ two different metrics: (1) the BLEU score (?), and (2) a content selection metric ...

answer_4.quote: We created a Mechanical Turk study and surveyed three unique respondents per statistic. We use the survey to assess the quality of each summary from four independent perspectives: (1) Informativeness ... (2) Conciseness ... (3) Coherence ... (4) Fluency ...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked four questions rating each summary on Informativeness, Conciseness, Coherence, and Fluency.
